stations.title: Idris
stations.say: What do these files actually say?

stations.title: Shop files
stations.text: Hundreds of orders and a log for each month.

stations.title: Top folder
stations.text: Four new files, each holding what was asked.

captions: At Ashgrove, Idris wants to know what the order list and the press logs say.
The files are hundreds of lines long, far too many to scroll through or copy.
You read them from the terminal and save what matters, in four small tasks.
Each answer sits in a file of its own, with just the lines that were asked for.
The accountant, Hesper and Idris have their answers, and no file was copied by hand.
